newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.African average T-Bill rate rises to 15.47 pct.
newsitem.headline: S.African average T-Bill rate rises to 15.47 pct.

text.p: The average discount rate for South African three-month Treasury Bills rose to 15.47 percent at the latest weekly tender after easing to 15.45 percent last week, the Reserve Bank said.
Applications for the 800 million rand of bills on offer totalled 1.590 billion rand. The average price was 96.145 rand percent.

The average rate for six-month bills was 14.88 percent from 14.85 percent. Applications for the 300 million rand of bills on offer totalled 760 million rand. The average price was 92.580 rand percent.
